title: What do the eight documentation steps measure?
question: What do the eight documentation steps measure?
answer:
LD-12: Cards represent destination concepts, distinct from constituent grilling prompts. Mixed progress shown as percentage distributions for questions and landmarks; no single card lane/reset lifecycle. Exact steps Idea, Aligning, Confirmed, Mapped, Planned, Journey, Review, Verified remain locked. Tracker generated; folder placement behavior needs reconciliation with corrected model.
LD-23: Destination concept/documentation progress toward durable destination, displayed as per-step percentage distribution. Each related item contributes actual step or mixed fractions totaling one. Same calculation for landmarks/Workbench, with shared items counted once. Tracker additive/documentation; Taskboard implementation. No child-completion proxy or reset lifecycle.
LD-26: Destination concept progress toward documentation destination, not child implementation completion. Wiki is agents brain and actual content is verified against expected durable knowledge.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: LD-12, LD-23, LD-26 (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
